# Fancy Chat

**Category:** Misc  
**Aliases:** Fancy Chat, FancyChat

## What it does

Change the "font" that you send messages with

Description basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features). The module's behavior on a stock Minecraft 26.3 server has not been verified unless separately documented in [research](../../RESEARCH.md).

## Client variants

### [Wurst — FancyChat](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/java/net/wurstclient/hacks/FancyChatHack.java)

Replaces ASCII characters in sent chat messages with fancier unicode characters. Can be used to bypass curse word filters on some servers. Does not work on servers that block unicode characters.

Basis: [publisher description](https://github.com/Wurst-Imperium/Wurst7/blob/4fa258b7b339f1823e73ae8455c404209e3690cd/src/main/resources/assets/wurst/translations/en_us.json).

### [Impact — Fancy Chat](https://impactclient.net/features)

Change the "font" that you send messages with

Basis: [publisher description](https://impactclient.net/features).

### [RusherHack — FancyChat](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/FancyChat.html)

Makes your text look gamer

Basis: [publisher description](https://rusherhack.org/features/modules/FancyChat.html).
